يعلولين (form XII)
# يَعْلَوْلِينَ (yaʕlawlīna) /jaʕ.law.liː.na/: third-person feminine plural non-past active indicative/subjunctive/jussive of اِعْلَوْلَى (iʕlawlā)
# يُعْلَوْلَيْنَ (yuʕlawlayna) /juʕ.law.laj.na/: third-person feminine plural non-past passive indicative/subjunctive/jussive of اِعْلَوْلَى (iʕlawlā)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
